Keep a young brown-haired woman in a plain white T-shirt and denim shorts and her cream snow Bengal cat (tan rosettes, clear blue eyes) consistent throughout, in a sunny suburban backyard. Shot 1 (0-1.8s, ROLL): the cat rolls the cat ball playpen across the grass, low follow shot. HARD CUT at 1.8s, no transition. Shot 2 (1.8-4s, PAYOFF): the cat rolling the cat ball playpen across the lawn, owner laughing behind; hard cut. The product always looks exactly like <<<image_1>>> and stays identical in both shots (same parts, same design); bags and boxes open naturally, plugs and fit look real, store shelves look lived-in rather than perfect. Background details: a living room with a sectional couch, a big flat-screen TV, a fireplace mantel with stockings. No text, no captions, no logos. A small American flag is visible in the background. Natural ambient sound only: real voices and action sounds that match what happens on screen, no added sound effects, no music.
